title: Does Tripo think fake promotions is going to get me to sign up?
author: Not-a-Clever-UN
selftext:
I'm curious, do people see the 60% and think that's what they'll actually pay and miss that it's not 60%?   It left a bitter taste in my mouth when I first saw it, so went with a year sub to Meshy that's worked pretty well but still doesn't do a few things I need.

Decided to give tripo another shot to see if it did anything better than Meshy, and it offered me 78%... and it's still just the same 35%/50% options from before.   

I asked on the discord how I got the 78% and they just banned me from their discord, lol.   

Someone said it did part splitting better, and was curious if it did on odd objects like something that looks kind of like a wood dog but has a lid.  Still tempted just for the test, but, also I've kicked myself for ignoring these red flags in the past.

comments.author: lambdita
comments.body: honestly, tripo makes me feel the same as when I open the temu app, its a nightmare to navigate and use and all the chinese-style fake ads and promotions, they make it ackward to use.

comments.author: guanzo91
comments.body: Idk but they’ve offered me a $4 sub renewal instead of the usual $20/mo for 2 months in a row, and I keep accepting it. Seems like a good deal to me.
